body:
We'll look more in detail, but a first quick answer around helper and events is that they are required for InstantSearch to function, so can't be tree-shaken. 

Hogan could be aliased to empty module if you know you aren't using any string templates, we might be able to make that an option/entry point, but I'm not sure how yet

The widgets and connectors should not have been included, I'm not sure what causes them to be imported, as the /es entry point purposely avoids adding it, but I wonder if vite somehow resolves the source instead of the dist files
